'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals John Veasey DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
